decisive_items: dull chest pain of 2 hours' duration
new discordant ST elevation of 1mm in leads II, III, and aVF
thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft proximal to circumflex anastomosis and occlusive lesions in proximal obtuse marginal artery
response.rationale: Clinical presentation, dynamic ECG changes, and catheterization-confirmed graft thrombosis are consistent with acute coronary syndrome despite an early negative troponin.
